structural_change: 2026-10-16 HC-COMB-3: CLOSED pr3ohf-65be8e18f (TT +82.40 / FF +0.26) FAILS the native audit: launch 279.7 ps (501 crd_o outputs) / capture 257.1 ps (716 ch_rd inputs), R 222.2. Cause: one crd flop per bit is both the W-pin input capture (ch_rd) and the E-pin output launch (crd_o) across the 151.2 um tile, plus the u_tree1 load, so GPL parks it mid-tile and both budgets fail. Fix: OREG=1 = a second register crd_q at the E pin (crd stays the W-pin capture + tree source); the pad chain gives the stage back (ot_s81_hc_cpad_split / _roots20 R0 6 -> 5, hard u_r6 = closed ot_s81_hc_pad_r5 master), so the return depth and every lockstep count are unchanged (0 cycles, bit-exact hc_gate). OT_OFLOP_PORT_RE dropped: crd_o is now a pure output flop seeded at the E pins. Same outline/faces.
